conviction_note: The primary documents point to another beat-and-raise on DPU (Aug-26 actual at or above 2,981 yen, the Feb-27 2,970 guide held or raised, a first Aug-27 guide carrying about 2.1bn yen of already-announced land gain plus newly acquired income, and an explicit company statement that it aims to keep raising the DPU level). But the gain was pre-announced on 2026-09-17, the company deferred only the Aug-27 number itself to this release, and the last four 短信 moved the stock -0.10, 0.00, -0.34 and -0.08% while a rate-driven 20-day slide (-7.8%) and a 236x margin long sit on the tape. So the findings sum to +0.35 and the scaled number is p_up 55 x abs 0.8 = +0.08: the gap is the reaction function vetoing a fundamentally positive read.
bar: Company DPU forecasts: Aug-2026 (49期) 2,981 yen and Feb-2027 (50期) 2,900 yen in the 2026-04-21 決算短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260421/140120260420507023.pdf), Feb-2027 lifted to an indicated 2,970 yen by the 2026-06-01 Edion Kyobashi disposition (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260601/140120260531556269.pdf); 2026-09-17 notice confirms 49期/50期 forecasts unchanged and Aug-2027 guide to come with this 短信. No 四季報/IFIS consensus DPU sourced, so findings are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-10-20: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, 0 sellers (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the sealed baseline). 信用倍率 236x per the baseline's broker scrape: retail margin long heavily crowded, the one setup in which a disappointment still has sellers. No skew in Japan. Kabutan 2026-10-09 rating log: Nikko kept 強気 but cut target 143,000 -> 138,000 yen (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8953&b=n202610090951). Tape: -7.81% over 20 sessions, -0.58% over 5, from 124,000 in Dec-2025 to 102,700; drift looks rate-driven rather than name-specific (refinancing notices show fixed 0.44-0.49% 10-year debt rolled into floating TIBOR-linked loans).

findings.finding: The Life Shimodera land sale (6.1bn yen, 2.5x appraisal, ~4.3bn gain) puts ~2.1bn yen (~290 yen/unit on 7,192,809 units) into the Aug-2027 period whose first DPU guide comes with this 短信, and the company wrote that with 5.5bn of gains secured since the last results plus an LOI-stage sale it expects to keep raising the DPU level -- so the first Aug-27 guide is likely at or above the Feb-27 level of 2,970 yen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raised at the last prints moved the stock little: 2025-10-20 短信 (Feb-26 guide 2,820->2,952) -0.34%; 2026-04-21 短信 (Aug-26 guide 2,950->2,981) -0.08%; standalone up-revisions 2025-08-27 -2.26% and 2025-12-19 -1.37% (Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8953.T?range=2y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The gain itself is public since 2026-09-17 (stock 111,400 -> 109,600 the next day, falling with the sector), but the company withheld the Aug-27 DPU number for this release; what the market does not have is the level, i.e. whether the gain plus reserves takes the guide above 2,970/3,000 or merely replaces reserve drawdowns. If it were priced as a step-up, the units would not be at a 10-month low with a 5.8% forward yield on 2,970 yen.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-17 supplemental (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260917/140120260916537274.pdf) shows the same gain schedule (66/51/11/21/21 億円 over 48-52期) -- same company, same day, counts once.

findings.finding: Since the April guide, JMF has committed ~23bn yen of new income assets -- a 8.79bn yen TK stake in 17 Seiyu land sites at ~4.7% unlevered yield with sales-linked rent from Nov-2026, JMF-Bldg Shin-Yokohama 01 (9.2bn, NOI 4.1%), m-City Toda Koen (4.87bn) and JMF Residence Osaka Awaji -- which feed the Feb-27 and Aug-27 forecasts and were not in the April numbers.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Acquisition announcements: 2026-08-21 TK +1.22% next day; 2026-09-30 Shin-Yokohama 0.00% (Yahoo daily closes).
findings.why_not_priced: Each deal was announced but none came with a forecast revision, so the DPU contribution is first quantified in this 短信; at roughly 20-30 yen/unit per half it is small against a 2,970 yen DPU, which is why it is sized small.
findings.independence: TK details in the 2026-08-21 supplemental, a separate document: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260821/140120260819523386.pdf

findings.finding: JMF's own record is beat-and-raise: Feb-2026 DPU came in at 3,006 against the 2,952 guided in Oct-2025, the Aug-2026 guide went 2,850 -> 2,950 (Dec-2025 revision) -> 2,981 (Apr-2026), so the Aug-2026 actual most likely prints at or a little above 2,981.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last four 短信 next-session moves: 2025-04-21 0.00%, 2025-10-20 -0.34%, 2026-04-21 -0.08%, plus 2025-04-17 -0.10% (Yahoo daily closes) -- reported DPU beats have not moved the units.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the pattern is visible in every 短信 and DPU is managed with reserve draws, so the period result lands inside what was guided; kept at near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: Oct-2025 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251020/140120251020575745.pdf) and Dec-2025 revision (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251219/140120251219522511.pdf) give the earlier guides.

findings.finding: Refinancing in Sept-2026 rolled maturing 10-year fixed loans at 0.441-0.494% into floating 1M TIBOR +0.150-0.200% loans, and the Sept-30 new debt is also floating, so interest cost rises into the Aug-27 period and caps core EPU (~2,550 yen per the June supplemental) as policy rates rise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to borrowing notices (2026-09-18 notice day -1.6% was a sector-wide down day; not attributable).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced -- this is the rate story the -7.8% run-down already reflects; what is left is the size of the interest line in the Aug-27 guide assumptions.

outside_window.finding: Second 50% tranche of the Life Shimodera sale settles 2027-09-30 and the further LOI-stage disposition is not yet contracted; their gains resolve in later periods.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive while the tape (-7.8% over 20 days, rate-driven) and the baseline lean (-0.80, mostly the 236x margin overhang) lean negative; the strongest positive the release can carry -- a first Aug-27 DPU guide above 2,970/3,000 -- was looked for and is signalled by the company itself, but it is partly pre-announced and this name has not moved more than 0.34% on any of its last four 短信, so the positive is kept small and p_up only at 55.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (negatives on public series toward 50) touches only the small -0.10 refinancing finding, already sized as mostly priced and not driving p_up; rule 2 (check for the strongest positive) was already done -- the call leans positive and the positive was searched for and sourced.
